shows.name: Red-eye Show
shows.description: The Red-eye Show is back! Join us 7PM–11PM for a laid-back night of cards, vendors, trades, and good vibes. Part of a two-shows, one-weekend combo with the Layover Card Show — one ticket gets you into both days, and kids under 12 are free.
highlights: One ticket covers both weekend shows
shows.vendor_description: Vendor table pricing is TBD — reach out to reserve your spot.

shows.name: Layover Card Show
shows.description: The Layover Card Show returns to RRGC Hall! Shop dozens of vendors, trade with fellow collectors, pull some packs, and hang out with the Vancouver card community. $5 at the door, or $3 online — one ticket covers both weekend shows (Red-eye Fri + Layover Sun), and kids under 12 are free.

shows.name: The Dreamliner Show
shows.description: Fasten your seatbelts — The Dreamliner Show is the LARGEST FREE card show in the Lower Mainland! Jetlagged Cards is going all out: 200+ tables across 17,000+ sq ft, a stamp rally, and a full lounge area. Zero admission. Come join us for the most fun you'll have at a card show. 🛫
shows.vendor_description: Secure your spot at the biggest free card show in the Lower Mainland.
